description: Land Reform Commission - Statutory Determination Under Section 19 of Land Reform Law No. 01 of 1972
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily concerned with land matters, specifically a statutory determination under the Land Reform Law regarding the retention of agricultural land by a statutory lessee. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (including lot numbers, locations, extents, and survey details) but does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories. The focus is exclusively on land ownership and allocation under land reform regulations.
